name: Long Recall Variant 6
task:
Please complete the following four-stage document analysis task.

=== Stage 1: Data Extraction ===
A 48-page school district report: 8 schools (page 3), 5,200 students (page 5), 320 teachers (page 8), budget $42M (page 12), test scores: math 78%, reading 82% (page 18), graduation rate 91% (page 22), 3 new programs (page 28), facility upgrades $5M (page 35).

=== Stage 2: Calculation ===
Compute required metrics from extracted data.

=== Stage 3: Cross-Verification ===
Verify calculations against document sections.

=== Stage 4: Summary ===
Compile all findings.
